text:
sre_pager: :rotating_light: ALERT: us-central1-primary GPU pool queue > 95% and steady growth. Autoscaler attempted +2 nodes but hit pool limit. Routing spillover triggered to region fallback policy (min weight).

maya: seeing 200s tail latency on gen endpoints, lots of 502/503 from front proxy. customer-facing dashboards show elevated 5xx.

ops-runbook-bot: Runbook link: https://runbooks/redwood/gpu-exhaustion. Suggested immediate actions: 1) Confirm autoscale error 2) Open emergency scale request 3) Enable spillover routing to secondary regions if not already.

sam: copying logs. autoscaler error: 
```
ERROR: failed to provision node: quotaExceeded: GPU quota 48 -> requested 56
```
We are at GPU quota for the account in us-central1.

josh: @sam can you confirm which pools are affected? primary-pool-1 and primary-pool-2?

sam: yes primary-pool-1 saturated, primary-pool-2 drained earlier (maintenance). primary-pool-1 is maxed at 48 GPUs, queued requests piling in. KV cache pressure high.

leila: Customer impact: spikes for near-production tenants. Seen repeated timeouts for AcmeAPI and three other enterprise tenants. I reached out to CSM to notify while we mitigate.

maya: I'm going to adjust routing weights to push more traffic to eu-west1 and west2 fallback pools. will update canary weight to 20% -> 60% for eu-west1.

sam: before that, confirm eu-west1 capacity: 
```
gcloud compute regions describe eu-west1 --project=redwood
# capacity free_gpus: 120
```
eu-west1 has headroom.

josh: I'm starting a manual scale request for us-central1 to ask infra quota owners for temporary bump, but that will take 20-30m. Need short-term routing change.

maya: doing routing change now: `POST /admin/routing` payload applied.

deploy-bot: deploy started by maya — routing-config v2026-03-15-01. Checking canary.

maya: canary shows 30% of traffic routed to eu-west1. Initial errors drop from 18%->9% but queue still growing in us-central1.

leila: CS updated: AcmeAPI experiencing intermittent failures, estimated impact 5-10% of requests. We're offering to route their traffic explicitly to eu-west1 if needed.

sam: autoscaler logs show scale throttled due to per-pool max nodes; there's also a cloud provider region-level quota preventing rapid provisioning. Manual eviction of lower-priority jobs possible.

josh: I'm evicting low-priority batch jobs in us-central1 now: `kubectl delete job --selector=job-type=batch-low`

ops-runbook-bot: Action recorded: evict low-priority batch jobs. Note: monitor reinsertion risk.

maya: after evictions, queue growth slowed but not reversed. We'll increase fallback weight to 75% for eu-west1 and 25% to west2. Applying.

sam: applied. Observability: user-facing latency per-route improved from 2.6s -> 1.1s median, tail 95th from 15s -> 4s. 5xx rate down to 3%. Still some backlog processing in us-central1.

josh: quota request for GPUs submitted to cloud-ops. Ticket #CLD-54213. They estimate 30-45 minutes for approval in emergency.

eva: I'll take the on-call handoff in ~10m. Maya, want to handover?

maya: yes please. Sam and Josh staying to monitor infra steps.

maya: Handoff: current mitigations — routing weight shift to eu-west1/west2, evicted batch jobs, manual scale request pending, contacting cloud-ops for quota bump. Customer notifications sent.

leila: Logged customer impact and timeline in incident board. Notifying security/compliance for any data residency concerns with cross-region routing (AcmeAPI asked about that).

eva: taking over monitoring. I'll keep canary at 75% eu-west1 for next 15m, then consider gradual ramp down if us-central1 recovers.

sam: cloud-ops replied: we can temporarily increase GPU quota in us-central1 by 8 GPUs within 25 mins, but can't do more without org-level approval. That will help but not fully clear queue.

maya: ok prioritize freeing a couple more GPUs: is there an idle dedicated pool we can temporarily attach?

josh: found a dedicated test pool east-us-aux with 12 free GPUs. Requesting attach to primary routing ring. This requires a config flip and will impact billing but saves latency.

eva: go ahead with attach. Coordinate with me for the routing switch.

deploy-bot: attach plan started by josh — updating pool assignments.

sam: attached east-us-aux -> added 12 GPUs to primary ring. Queue reduced immediately, 5xx down to 1.2%, latencies back near baseline.

maya: excellent. I'll start rollback of heavy cross-region routing back to conservative levels (eu-west1 30%, west2 10%).

leila: CSM confirmed AcmeAPI is ok with temporary cross-region traffic; they asked for post-incident report re: latency metrics and request IDs.

eva: I'll stay on and run postmortem. Action items: 1) Request permanent quota increase for us-central1 2) Improve autoscaler to detect per-pool caps and auto-failover earlier 3) Add playbook snippet to attach auxiliary pools automatically 4) Customer comms draft.

sam: adding metrics and logs to incident ticket. Will follow up on quota approval and autoscaler change backlog.

maya: thanks everyone. marking incident as mitigated — ongoing monitoring. :white_check_mark:

sre_pager: INCIDENT UPDATE: Mitigated at 2418007905 — primary latency and 5xx within service SLOs. Postmortem assigned to eva, sam, josh.

eva: I'll open the postmortem doc and schedule a review with CS and infra tomorrow.

josh: locking this thread and creating a followup RFC for autoscaler pool-awareness.

leila: closing customer notifications after postmortem draft.

ops-runbook-bot: Incident closed in runbook. Remember to undo any temporary pool attachments within 72h unless approved.
